messages:
Sam: Noticed a weird chart on the latency panel for /v1/embeddings: p50 line sits above p95 for several minutes during yesterday's canary. Looks wrong.
Priya: Hmm. Do you have the exact time window and query?
Sam: Window 2024-11-10T14:12:00Z -> 14:30Z. Panel uses `percentile(50,95,99)` over 1m rollup with a 5m smoothing window.
Luca: Smoothing + downsampling can invert quantiles if bucket boundaries cut across the heavy tail. Also if we interpolate between sparse buckets we can get p50>p95 anomalies.
Priya: Could also be that the panel is merging per-endpoint rollups where one endpoint has a small but very high tail. Did the canary change routing targets then?
Sam: Canary weight timeline: 14:10 0% -> 14:15 20% -> 14:18 60% -> 14:25 100%. The spike/inversion matches the middle of that ramp.
console-team: Current UX merges per-backend tdigests for the charting layer then smooths. For high-cardinality endpoints we downsample to centroids before smoothing. That sequence is fragile for percentiles.
ops-bot: alert: percentile-inversion-detected /v1/embeddings (2024-11-10T14:20Z)
Luca: Quick repro idea: recreate two populations A (p95 0.12s) and B (p95 1.8s) and simulate ramp. Merge + smoothing can produce intermediate sketches where the estimated 50th > estimated 95th for the merged sketch at some timesteps.
Priya: For a practical fix: (1) change visualization order -> compute percentiles from merged histogram after smoothing rather than smoothing percentiles; (2) highlight per-backend lines; (3) add an inversion guard: if p50>p95, show raw histogram popup and mark as "sketch inconsistency".
Sam: Agree. If we can surface the routing timeline on the same panel (small stacked area under the chart) that would make it obvious this was caused by ramping weights.
console-team: Implementation notes: merging histograms post-smoothing is more expensive. We can do it only for visible charts or when sample_count < X. Also adding a little provenance pill that says: "percentiles computed from merged sketches (contributors: 3)".
Luca: Also add a debug mode for oncall that can toggle "exact recompute" which fetches raw buckets and computes exact percentiles for the window. Useful when pctl anomalies happen.
Priya: I can prototype UI overlays: routing weight step timeline + quota-events marks + per-backend mini-sparklines. UX should default to merged view but have a one-click "Show per-backend".
Sam: Can we also improve alerting? Right now ops-bot alerts on merged p95 increase; we should suppress or de-duplicate alerts when p50>p95 and instead create a low-confidence alert that references per-backend checks.
console-team: Will open PR for tooltip text: "If you see percentile inversion, try toggling per-backend view or enable exact recompute. Inversions often come from merging + smoothing of sketches." 
ops-bot: info: scheduled a thunderdump job to capture raw buckets for /v1/embeddings 14:12-14:30 for diagnostics.
Luca: Long-term: consider storing short-term exact histograms for endpoints with frequent rollouts or high routing churn. That lets us answer exact queries for recent windows without expensive replays.
Priya: Action items: Priya -> mock overlay + per-backend toggle; console-team -> add inversion guard and tooltip; operations -> tweak alert rules to prefer per-backend signals; Sam -> attach the thunderdump artifacts to the ticket.
Sam: Thanks, everyone. Attaching small GIF of the inversion to the issue.
